methodology.pageSourceFiles: Count of app/page.tsx source files; this is not a claim about all runtime URLs or indexable routes.
methodology.routeCoverage: Dynamic route handlers serve multiple slugs; localized route equivalents are reported as counts only, not percentages of page source files.
methodology.sharedUiModuleCoverage: Leaf strings in lib/i18n/shared-ui.ts only; does not measure every component or form.
methodology.pdfGuideCoverage: Nepali guide entries compared with the English tool guide registry.
methodology.blogCoverage: Registered localized article records compared with English editorial and Nepal article records.
methodology.review: Automation cannot certify native-speaker or human editorial review.
